_doc: Symbol dictionary + decl associations for FOL↔Lean alignment (tools/align.js). 'decls' maps a FOL definition/theorem box id to the Lean declaration it formalizes (name + source file, relative to the oai_math Lean project). 'symbols' maps a FOL symbol NAME (authored sym, else span slug) to its Lean meaning: {lean} is the Lean const/op; sort:true = a typing/sort predicate (carried by a Lean binder TYPE, not the proposition); lean:'not-mem' = negated membership (∉); lean:'apply' = higher-order application where the first FOL arg is the function (matrix applied to indices). name:true = the definiendum.
_doc_tuples: FOL variables that denote a TUPLE, so one ∀ over them corresponds to several Lean binders (e.g. v5 ≡ (s,j), a 2-tuple). Value = arity. Declared, not guessed — absent ⇒ one ∀ must match exactly one Lean binder, else flagged.
